title: Interfacial Bi–O–Zn bonding induces faster charge transfer in S-scheme Bi-MOF/ZnFe2O4 heterojunction for enhanced photocatalytic tetracycline elimination
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1908-1921
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01157K, Paper
Hui Li, Zhu Zhu, Kai Yang, Kangqiang Lu, Xirong Chen, Weiya Huang, Zhaoqing Liu
ZnFe2O4 nanosheets were grown in situ on Bi-MOF nanorods by a facile hydrothermal method, creating S-scheme heterojunctions with interfacial Bi–O–Zn bonds. This accelerated the separation of charge carriers and improved the photocatalytic activity.
